title: The Old Model Plane
question: 把今天“偏远角落发现旧物 -> 状况不坏 -> 值得抢救 -> 安排清洁修复 -> 保存故事”的表达，放进 school storeroom 场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: We found an old model plane in a remote corner of the storeroom. It was dusty, but it wasn't too badly damaged. Our teacher said it was worth rescuing because it told a story about the science club. We had it cleaned and repaired. Now we are going to have it restored and display it near the science room.

options.label: A
options.scenario_zh: 说明旧模型飞机在哪里被发现
options.english_template: We found an old model plane in ___ of the storeroom.

options.label: B
options.scenario_zh: 说明它虽然旧，但损坏不严重

options.label: D
options.scenario_zh: 用 had something done 说明已经安排清洁

options.label: E
options.scenario_zh: 用 have something done 说明准备修复
options.english_template: Now we are going to ___ and display it.
